rule.easy_win: Only a fully AUTO_VERIFIED record with API YES, SELF_SERVE credential access, documented auth, BROAD/MODERATE API, BUILDABLE_NOW, and no partner/enterprise/paid gate.

rule.needs_review: MIXED, NOT_CHECKED, any UNKNOWN critical value, or missing auth method. Never auto-classified as Easy-win/Outreach.
